name: Marco Bellini
bio:
Marco Bellini's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, trading pasta recipes for pit lane passes after befriending a local racing team owner in his hometown of Modena. He quickly realized the paddock's need for authentic Italian cuisine, offering comfort and a taste of home to the often-stressed drivers and crew. Marco's dedication to quality and his ability to adapt his menus to dietary restrictions and cultural preferences have made him a vital part of any team he joins.

His commitment to excellence extends beyond the food itself; he sees catering as a form of team building, creating a welcoming and social atmosphere that fosters camaraderie and boosts morale. Marco understands that a well-fed team is a focused team, and his meticulous attention to detail ensures that everyone has the energy and nourishment they need to perform at their best. He's known for his signature tiramisu, a racing weekend staple for Manthey EMA.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Marco is a stocky man with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Always hums opera tunes while cooking
Insists on using only imported Italian olive oil, even for the simplest dishes
Keeps a small photo of Enzo Ferrari in his catering van
